procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Optional case law/memos may reach JA by email or courthouse notebook three days before hearing; copy other parties.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Zoom98525703348; generally request remote appearance by motion. SectionH specifically directs counsel to attend CMC by Zoom and self-represented litigants in person unless excused.
